default_in_repayment.text:
(a) The Company has not defaulted in repayment of loans or other borrowings or in the payment of interest as applicable thereon to any lender.
(b) The Company has not been declared wilful defaulter by any bank or financial institution or government or any government authority.
(c) Term loans were applied for the purpose for which the loans were obtained.
(d) On an overall examination of the standalone financial statements of the Company, no funds raised on short-term basis have been used for long-term purposes by the Company.
(e) On an overall examination of the standalone financial statements of the Company, the Company has not taken any funds from any entity or person on account of or to meet the obligations of its subsidiary.
(f) The Company has not raised loans during the year on the pledge of securities held in its subsidiary. Hence, the requirement to report on clause (ix)(f) of the Order is not applicable to the Company.

fraud.text:

tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: Our Company (“Appellants”) filed a Memorandum of Appeal before the Commissioner of Central Tax (Appeals) (“CIT(A)”) against the Assistant Commissioner of Central Tax (“Respondent”) for disparity in Input Tax Credits availed. The Respondent issued a show cause notice dated March 18, 2022 to pay ineligible Input Tax Credits amounting to Rs. 18.69 million availed on Goods and Services Tax (“GST”) alongside penalty of 10% in keeping with Section 50(3) of the Central Goods and Services Tax Act of 2017. The Appellant filed a response in contestation dated June 9, 2022 and was heard by the Respondent on October 27, 2023, leading to an order confirming the ITC demand as well as interest of 10% aggregating Rs. 20.56 million, giving rise to this appeal. The Appellants thereby filed an appeal before the CIT(A) at Bengaluru, Karnataka, for setting aside of the order.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹136.39 Cr, net profit to shareholders ₹22.98 Cr.
Brigade Hotel Ventures filed the Monitoring Agency Report for Q4FY26 regarding Pre-IPO and IPO proceeds utilization on April 28, 2026.
Brigade Hotel Ventures Limited uploaded Q4 FY 2026 conference call recording on April 29, 2026, hosted by **Akanksha Bijawat**, **Company Secretary**.
Brigade Hotel Ventures reported Q4 FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹146 Cr and net profit of ₹25 Cr
Brigade Hotel Ventures and Marriott International opened the 218-room Courtyard by Marriott Kochi Infopark, an upgraded and rebranded hotel.
Brigade Hotel Ventures outlined a ₹1,000 Cr investment plan over the next five years in Karnataka on the 10th anniversary of Grand Mercure Mysuru.
Brigade Hotel Ventures issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for material related-party transactions up to ₹290 Cr with holding company Brigade Enterprises Limited.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹138.24 Cr (+10.0% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹19.94 Cr (+119.8% YoY).
Brigade Hotel Ventures reported Q2 FY27 consolidated total income of ₹142 Cr and net profit of ₹22 Cr, reflecting strong rate-led RevPAR growth and lower finance costs.
Brigade Hotel Ventures Limited uploaded the audio recording of its Q2 FY 2027 conference call held on October 27, 2026 to its website.
